author: Gavin (gmarcialcalleja)
summary: Connect final-consumer expiry and depth policy to simulated haptics
details: Opt-in local policy keeps health separate from hazards, recovers sectors from distinct covered frames, preserves original capture deadlines and cancels on loss. Trusted phone source/boot binding and explicit measured drift gate native clock/depth reception; unknown drift defaults unavailable. Simulated outputs only; no GPIO or crossing permission.
validation: 71 edge and 41 shared tests passed on Windows/Linux. Synthetic verified-TLS native phone relay test exercised clock exchange, depth, simulated left pulse and interruption cancellation. Real phone/Pi policy, drift, mount and electrical acceptance remain outstanding; earlier Pi vision evidence is retained separately.
